{{Top|leg}}
'''"Butcher's Alley"''' was a nickname given after [[4800 BBY]] to the main approach to the [[Kaikielius system/Legends|Kaikielius system]] on the [[Koros Trunk Line/Legends|Koros Trunk Line]]. It gained its name because of the presence of [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] in the system.
